szoveg_eredeti:
Simulations let you close the loop faster without waiting for real world feedback. Perplexity Computer is getting really good at practical simulations that matter for business owners.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Jeff Grimes (@jeffgrimes9); megjelent: 2026-11-22T18:41:40+00:00; link: https://x.com/jeffgrimes9/status/2124574047996645884; média: videó, 91 másodperc]
A DTC e-commerce business built an unboxing simulator with Perplexity.

It's a 3D interactive app that visualizes a customer's experience unboxing their product, with the ability to redesign the packaging, showing updated materials cost.

Built in Three.js with Rapier physics. Every item and sound effect was generated in code.
